risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (311), rising dollar, imminent NFP event, and approaching earnings create a highly hostile trading environment for financials.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (50/200 EMA bullish, Supertrend bullish) combined with extreme market fear (30/100) and contrarian buy signal creates asymmetric risk-reward for patient swing traders willing to wait for momentum confirmation.
